oneCauseOrFive.answer: THREE causes, not one and not five.

causeA.cause: pdf-lib regenerates an appearance the source already carried, and flatten stamps the regeneration onto the filing. form.updateFieldAppearances() repaints any widget whose current /AS state has no entry in /AP /N; under ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 a conforming viewer paints nothing there, so whatever pdf-lib invents is ink the issuer never authored.
causeA.codeShape: NOT one shared module at the outset. California went through the shared finalizer, which already implemented the remedy behind suppressSynthesizedAppearances. Maryland and Missouri each carried a byte-identical PRIVATE copy of flattenWithoutDeleting() — md line 733, mo line 919 — calling updateFieldAppearances() with no suppression and unable to reach the finalizer's flag at all. One cause, three sites, two of them copy-paste duplicates.
causeA.fixedOnceAt: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs :: suppressSynthesizedSelectionAppearances — imported by both builders rather than reimplemented, so no third copy was created. The module itself was not modified.

causeB.cause: flat overlay geometry. No AcroForm is involved: the builder draws with page.drawText at hand-authored rectangles and its fitText() validates a value only against its own rectangle width, never against what the form already prints at that spot. Unrelated to cause A in mechanism, in code and in remedy.

causeC.cause: written values wider than the source form's own widget BBox, clipped at the BBox so the rendered page showed a truncated case number and name while the text layer still carried the whole string and a text-only check reported them present. Remedy is fit-or-refuse, which is neither of the other two.

oneCauseOrFive.consequence: Fixing it once at the cause is right for CA/MD/MO and would have been actively wrong for FL and AR. CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP is a category here, not a diagnosis: on these five it covers added ink at unticked boxes, re-laid-out issuer chrome, overlay-versus-printed-ink collision, and BBox overflow.
